chunks: So that Truth may be affirmed and falsehood negated, even though the sinners be averse.
ai.seo_question: What is the purpose of the Quran and divine victory according to Surah Al-Anfal?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the inevitability of divine truth prevailing over falsehood, regardless of the opposition's resistance, reflecting the concept of *Haqq* as an objective reality established by God. It highlights that victory is not merely military but spiritual, affirming the Quran's role in purifying the community from *Batil*. This assurance serves as a comfort to the believers during times of trial, reminding them that God's decree supersedes human preference.
